Define the r-neighborhood Nr (v, G) = (v, G ), where VaG ⊆ VaG , ClG ⊆ ClG are the sets of vertices reachable from v by a path of length at most r and EG is the set of edges on those paths. Further, define Nr (v, G, ρ, ϕ) = (v, G , ρ , ϕ ) ∈ Λ, where (v, G ) = Nr (v, G) and ρ = ρ G , ϕ = ϕ G are the restrictions of ρ, ϕ to G . Definition II.11 (r-local function). A function f with domain Λ is r-local if the value of f (v, G, ρ, ϕ) depends only on the isomorphism class of Nr (v, G, ρ, ϕ). In other words, a local function has access to the topology of the r-neighborhood, the vertex and edge decorations, and the location of the root, but not the identities of the vertices and edges. Definition II.12 (r-local algorithm). Let f be an r-local function with codomain {T, F}.
